description:
Grow is a departure from the slightly brighter neo-soul sound of Necktr's debut EP, ‘Something’s Happening’, and sets the scene with a focus on the bands West African and atmospheric influences, before venturing into the realms of angular fusion and cinematic soundscapes. The track features vocalists Esme Bridie and B-âhwe, as well as violinist Jed Holland. 

Included as part of this release, Necktr have also collaborated with some of Leeds’ finest producers to put together a series of remixes of ‘Grow’, as well as their previous single ‘Cold Water’. This includes remixes by Sourpuss, Breaka, Adam Pits and Dubrunner, making the package a celebration of Leeds’ vibrant electronic and jazz / world music scenes.
credits:
